title: Chicken Seekh Kabab

ingredients.title: For the Kababs
items: Chicken mince – 500 g, finely minced, thigh preferred
Onion – 1 medium, finely grated and moisture squeezed out
Fresh coriander leaves – 3 tbsp, finely chopped
Fresh mint leaves – 2 tbsp, finely chopped
Cumin seeds – 1 tsp, toasted and ground
Coriander seeds – 1 tsp, toasted and ground
Roasted gram flour (besan) – 2 tbsp, lightly dry-roasted

ingredients.title: For Cooking & Basting
items: Butter or oil – as needed for basting

ingredients.title: For Optional Smoky Finish
items: Ghee or oil – a few drops

instruction.title: Prepare the Mixture
steps: Place the finely minced chicken in a large mixing bowl.
Add squeezed grated onion, ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, coriander leaves, and mint leaves.
Add toasted and ground cumin seeds, toasted and ground coriander seeds, garam masala, Kashmiri red chili powder, black pepper, chaat masala, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the egg and roasted gram flour.
Mix and knead thoroughly with your hand for 8–10 minutes until the chicken mixture becomes sticky and cohesive.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight for deeper flavor.

instruction.title: Shape the Kababs
steps: Lightly grease the seekh skewers and wet your hands with water or oil.
Take a portion of the chilled chicken mixture and press it evenly around a skewer.
Shape it into a long, even cylinder approximately 6–7 inches long.
If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes before shaping.
Repeat with the remaining chicken mixture.

instruction.title: Cook – Tandoor or Grill
steps: Preheat the tandoor or barbecue grill to high heat.
Place the chicken seekh kababs over the heat.
Cook until golden and cooked through with lightly charred spots.
Turn regularly and baste occasionally with butter or oil to keep the kababs juicy.

instruction.title: Cook – Oven Method
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Place the skewers on a greased rack positioned over a baking tray.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, turning once halfway through.
Broil for 2–3 minutes at the end to develop a lightly charred exterior.
Baste with butter or oil during cooking as needed.

instruction.title: Cook – Pan Method
steps: Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and lightly grease it.
Place the shaped chicken seekh kababs in the pan.
Cook while turning occasionally until evenly browned and cooked through.
Baste with butter or oil during cooking for added richness.

instruction.title: Optional Smoky Finish
steps: Heat a small piece of charcoal until red-hot.
Place a small heatproof steel bowl inside the tray with the cooked kababs.
Put the hot charcoal into the bowl and drizzle a few drops of ghee or oil over it.
Immediately cover the tray with a lid or foil and let the smoke infuse for about 2 minutes.
Remove the charcoal before serving.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Serve the hot chicken seekh kababs with mint chutney, onion rings, and lemon wedges.
For an upscale presentation, sprinkle lightly with chaat masala and garnish with microgreens.

chefTips: Chicken: Use thigh mince for juicier kababs; lean breast mince tends to dry out more quickly.
Moisture control: Squeeze the grated onion thoroughly to prevent excess moisture from making the kababs fall apart.
Binding: Knead the chicken mixture for 8–10 minutes until sticky and cohesive for secure skewer binding.
Resting: Chilling the mixture allows the flavors to develop and makes shaping easier.
Cooking: Avoid overcooking chicken seekh kababs, as they can become dry.
Skewers: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes before cooking to reduce the risk of burning.
